strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship a personal weak-network VPN with a portable Windows 11 client and self-contained Linux amd64/arm64 server bundles. Sustained payload remains WBD-owned raw TCP-shaped FakeTCP -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK; Reality-like TLS is setup/admission only.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: Real Ubuntu use of the sequence-54 Linux bundle exposed a deterministic launch defect: WBD_LISTEN_IP=0.0.0.0 was passed to raw FakeTCP although wbd-faketcp-mux requires a concrete IPv4. The report also showed LINK UDP 127.0.0.1:47000 occupied, a systemd restart counter of 123, and fragile ExecStop kill usage. The Linux manager now resolves a primary concrete IPv4 only for FakeTCP while keeping Reality on the wildcard listener, removes explicit ExecStop, uses control-group teardown, caps restart bursts, and logs the resolved bind. Regression CI covers the wildcard case. Linux release checksums were also made portable.
